jobs.description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

The Growth Platform Team is a key part of Raisin’s B2C Experience Tribe, powering the infrastructure behind our growth engine. Our mission is to empower product teams and marketers alike to learn fast and grow smarter. We do this by providing the tools, backend services, and integrations that drive measurable outcomes. From A/B testing infrastructure and user analytics to bonus systems and affiliate tooling, the team enables data-driven growth initiatives across Raisin's B2C platforms.

You’ll work at the intersection of product, marketing, engineering, and data — empowering teams across Raisin to test ideas, measure outcomes, and scale what works. If you thrive on cross-functional collaboration and want to make a measurable impact on how we grow, this is the team for you.


Your Responsibilities

  • Own and evolve our experimentation and A/B testing infrastructure to support rapid learning across teams.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineers and Analysts to instrument tracking and enable granular behavioural insights.
  • Drive initiatives like Refer-a-Friend, bonuses, and retention programs, balancing customer incentives with business outcomes.
  • Integrate key marketing technologies (e.g. affiliate tracking) into our product and data stack.
  • Work with Engineering to prioritise and deliver growth-enabling capabilities with high quality and efficiency.
  • Lead backlog refinement and discovery rituals with engineering, ensuring high alignment and focus.
  • Contribute to quarterly planning (OKRs) and define clear success metrics for your domain.

Your Profile

  • 2+ years of experience in a product role, ideally in B2C, and/or in a growth-focused role.
  • Experience working with experimentation frameworks and A/B testing setups
  • Strong collaboration skills across product, data, marketing, and tech
  • Actively using AI in your workflow. You reach for it for research, spec drafts, data exploration, and experiment design, and have a point of view on where it helps and where it doesn't.
  • Solid understanding of tracking, analytics, and attribution concepts.
  • Strong technical fluency. You can collaborate closely with engineers on backend services and APIs.
  • Analytical mindset. You are confident using data to define success and drive decisions
  • You are proactive, structured, and outcome-driven

Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from:

  • Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.
  • Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.

jobs.title: Product Manager (parental leave cover)
jobs.description:
About Tandem Tandem is the leading global language learning community, with over 35 million members from all around the world practicing languages together. The concept of learning from each other is not only core to the Tandem community, it is also at the heart of how we work every day at Tandem. 

 We are based in Berlin, profitable and growing, and backed by top European investors. We are highly international and driven by a shared passion for languages, technology, and culture. Together, we are on a mission to connect the world through languages, by building a product that helps people not just learn, but truly understand each other across cultures. 

 We are looking for a bright, data-driven, collaborative operator to help us improve the experience of our members.  

 Your role will be to: Run the experiment loop: hypothesis, spec, launch, readout, ship or kill. Keep a steady cadence of live tests. 

 Find the next bets from data, research, and member feedback - not from a backlog of random ideas. 

 Spec and land a small number of features with design and engineering; you are accountable for the outcome, not the ticket. 

 Share results in a way the rest of Tandem can act on. 

 

 You are the right fit for the role if you: Have 3+ years of product management experience, including consumer mobile apps at scale. 

 Are analytical: you know the metrics that matter, can reason about experiments and statistical results, and are fluent in product analytics. 

 Have a proactive, independent way of working, with leadership and ownership you can point to - not only ideas, but things you shipped. 

 Are a clear communicator and a strong collaborator, with excellent written and spoken English. 

 Care about simple, intuitive user experiences and can work closely with design to get there. 

 Like hard problems and stay with them until they are solved. 

 Use AI in your own work to move faster, and are thoughtful about where it belongs in product operations. 

 

 The benefits 
Passion for languages:  
 We’re a team of 30 people speaking 20 languages fluently between us. For those wanting to improve their German (or Denglisch!), you can join one of our German classes on us. 

 Take a deep dive:  
 As a Tandem team member, we’ll give you a budget for up to 6 “Deep Dive Days” per year. Pick a topic you’ve always wanted to explore for your professional development that has never made it out of your backlog. Then book a cabin in the woods or whatever matches your individual learning style. 

 Teams who train together, stay together:  
 We offer Urban Sports Club gym memberships to boost our team’s physical and mental health. If you prefer, we can contribute to your monthly public transport ticket instead. 

 It takes a team to Tandem:  
 Bonding with our teammates outside of our normal work routine is important to us. We organize regular team events: from day trips to monthly lunches, summer BBQs, and movie nights. 

 Balance matters:  
 Life isn’t just about work. We know when to snooze Slack notifications, recharge our batteries, and take time out for our personal hobbies. As home office has become the new normal for some of us, it’s even more important to be able to switch off from work and relax. 

 Modern family:  
 As part of our family-friendly company philosophy, we embrace flexible working hours, welcome families to our events, and love for our kids to visit the office and get a taste of life at Tandem. 

 Relocation without the stress:  
 If you’re looking to relocate to Berlin, we’re ready to assist you with the infamous German bureaucracy. Many of us have been through it before, so we have plenty of tips to share. You’ll feel settled in no time. 

 Hybrid by design:  
 We’re all about embracing a flexible, modern way of working. That’s why we focus on a hybrid approach—balancing time between our vibrant Berlin-Mitte office and the comfort of your home. It’s the best of both worlds, and we’ll support you in creating the perfect setup for this dynamic way of working.

jobs.description:
Intro Adsquare's mission is centered on: 
 Passion: Solving complex challenges with exceptional people, technology, and data. 

 Niche: Specializing in Location Intelligence for Programmatic Advertisers. 

 
 
 Our work is guided by our core values, and we look for candidates who embody them: 
 Drive: Turning ambition into action that brings valuable outcomes. 

 Resilience: Adapting, persevering, and growing stronger through challenges. 

 No BS: Upholding honesty, transparency, and clear communication. 

 Humble: Valuing modesty and letting results speak for themselves. 

 Moral Compass: Acting with fairness, integrity, and respect. 

 

 About the team You'll join Adsquare's Data Products team, responsible for the pipelines and signals that power our Location Intelligence solutions. Working closely with our Lead PM for Data Products and a squad of data engineers, you'll help ingest, process, and scale the supplier and panel data that fuels our products. Your squad sits at the intersection of engineering, data governance, and downstream teams like Measurement and Activation, ensuring the signals we deliver are fast, reliable, and trustworthy. 

 Your Mission As Product Owner for SDV Data Products (f/m/d), you'll own your squad's delivery, turning strategy into clear, testable backlog items while managing the technical scale of our core data pipelines. You'll be the primary technical counterpart to our data suppliers and panel partners, driving the operational reliability that keeps our signals fresh and trusted. 

 Your Profile 3-5 years of experience as a Product Owner or technical PM, ideally in AdTech, MarTech, or another data-heavy ecosystem. 

 Strong at managing delivery and technical scale: sequencing complex backend work, mapping dependencies, and scoping against time, whether working with engineers, architects, or integration teams. 

 Operationally rigorous: comfortable thinking in SLIs, SLOs, freshness, match rate, and MTTR, not just features shipped, and skilled at running a tight, testable backlog. 

 Data-fluent, with required SQL proficiency: able to independently query internal data sources to investigate supplier data, panel quality, and pipeline KPIs, and bring quantified evidence into prioritisation. 

 Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make decisions with limited information and translate business intent clearly for engineering. 

 A privacy-aware product thinker who understands data governance and how evolving privacy frameworks affect upstream ingestion and pipeline logic. 

 A clear communicator across altitudes, able to translate strategy into specs and engineering reality into product trade-offs. 

 A true owner who drives outcomes without step-by-step direction and surfaces tensions upward rather than resolving them quietly. 

 

 What you will do Own and maintain your squad's backlog, working closely with the Lead PM for Data Products to translate strategy into clear, testable user stories. 

 Lead the roadmap for modernising, scaling, and optimising our core data ingestion and processing pipelines to handle high-throughput workloads. 

 Manage internal dependencies — SLAs, schema contracts, and joint roadmap touchpoints — with downstream squads such as Measurement, Activation, and Data Products. 

 Coordinate releases of new schemas, ingestion endpoints, match logic changes, and signal product enhancements. 

 Act as the primary PO-level counterpart to data supplier and panel partner technical teams, co-owning ingestion specs and schema contracts. 

 Support the Lead PM on new supplier partnerships and panel expansion through feasibility input, integration scoping, and prototype delivery. 

 Define, own, and report on operational KPIs such as signal freshness, SLA adherence, panel coverage, schema validation pass rate, and match rate. 

 Establish SLIs, SLOs, and escalation paths in partnership with engineering, and own the operational visibility layer (dashboards, alerts) that surfaces data product health.

 Prior experience collaborating directly with identity vendors, panel providers, or purchase-data suppliers on schema and integration work.

jobs.title: Product Owner (all genders)
jobs.description:
Deine Rolle bei uns Digitalisierung ist kein Buzzword, sondern eine Haltung.

In deiner Rolle als Product Owner  (all genders)   gestaltest du digitale Produkte, Prozesse und Lösungen, die echten Nutzen schaffen – für Anwender:innen, Organisationen und anspruchsvolle Projekte.

Du verantwortest die Produktvision, übersetzt Anforderungen in umsetzbare Lösungen und bringst Fachbereiche, IT, Stakeholder:innen und externe Partner:innen an einen Tisch. Dabei denkst du nicht nur agil oder klassisch – sondern situativ das, was wirklich funktioniert. 

 Welche Aufgaben auf dich warten Digitale Lösungen gestalten & weiterentwickeln Du entwickelst Ideen und Zielbilder für digitale Produkte, Prozesse und Lösungen.
 Du strukturierst und priorisierst Anforderungen und übersetzt sie gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten in umsetzbare Lösungen.
 Du begleitest digitale Lösungen über verschiedene Phasen hinweg – von der Konzeption bis zur Einführung und Weiterentwicklung.
 Projekte steuern & Umsetzung begleiten Du planst und koordinierst IT- und Digitalisierungsprojekte und behältst Ziele, Termine, Qualität und Ressourcen im Blick.
 Du schaffst Transparenz über Fortschritt, Abhängigkeiten und offene Entscheidungen.
 Du sorgst gemeinsam mit den Projektbeteiligten dafür, dass aus Konzepten funktionierende Lösungen werden.
 Anforderungs‑ & Stakeholder‑Management Du nimmst Anforderungen auf, hinterfragst und strukturierst sie und stimmst sie mit den relevanten Beteiligten ab.
 Du moderierst unterschiedliche Interessen und führst Entscheidungen herbei.
 Du begleitest Veränderungen und unterstützt dabei, neue Prozesse und Lösungen erfolgreich in der Organisation zu verankern.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Core People Technology
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager, Core People Technology
 Location: London | Work model: Hybrid | Reports to: Senior Manager, People Product
 
 About the team
 People Technology builds and runs the systems behind every hire, transfer, leave, pay change and offboard for our workforce across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. Our mission is to make the operational backbone of People Operations invisible when it works — reliable, compliant, and scalable across dozens of markets — so our people teams can focus on people, not process. This role sits on the People Product team, working alongside Business Systems Analysts, engineers and delivery leadership to bring product thinking to one of our highest-volume, highest-consequence surfaces.
 
 About the role
 Core is the Workday and HR platform surface that nearly every People Operations process runs through — pay, leave, employment status, right to work, and multi-country compliance for a global workforce. Demand structurally exceeds capacity, and requests arrive from every direction without a shared shape. You'll be the first dedicated product manager for this space, responsible for turning that inbound chaos into a defensible, well-communicated plan — and, over time, for building the intake, frameworks and partnerships that let the space run on systems rather than on you.
 This is a hands-on individual contributor role: you'll be shaping tickets and sizing work alongside analysts and engineers, not managing from above.
 
 What you'll be doing
 Own the prioritised order of work for Core — building a clear, ranked plan, explaining the reasoning behind it, and being explicit about what's being deferred and why

 Turn vague or incomplete partner requests into documented problems, mapped current-state processes, and testable outcomes

 Partner directly and regularly with People Operations, Compliance, Payroll, Total Rewards and Business Systems Analysts, including holding "not now" conversations without damaging the relationship

 Work hands-on with analysts and engineers to shape, size, and write tickets, keeping an accurate and current picture of committed, shipped, and carried-over work

 Build and evolve the operating model across the analyst and engineering pod — the mechanisms, documentation and intake processes that let the space run with less coordination overhead

 Use AI tools to accelerate translation of messy, multi-format, multi-language inbound requests into structured requirements and plans, while applying clear judgment about what should never be automated (anything touching pay, leave, employment status or right to work)

 Escalate proactively on statutory or audit exposure, cross-space dependencies, and any trade-off that would move a compliance date

 Report progress and delivery against plan to partners and leadership, including clear communication when outcomes fall short

 Requirements
 Experience owning a product or systems area end-to-end, with real decision rights over scope and sequencing — not co-ownership of a feature

 Hands-on background with Workday or a comparable HRIS as a product manager or technical program manager, with genuine understanding of configuration, business processes, and integrations

 Demonstrated ability to prioritise when demand structurally exceeds capacity, including a repeatable method (not just instinct) for deciding what to do and communicating what won't get done

 Proven delivery in ambiguous, fast-moving environments, comfortable starting when requirements are incomplete or undocumented

 Experience translating a partner's requested solution into a well-defined problem, current-state understanding, and testable outcome

 Strong collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders, including compliance, payroll, or other regulated/audit-exposed functions

 Practical fluency with AI tools for requirements drafting, documentation, and structuring unstructured information, paired with sound judgment about where not to apply them

 Why Deliveroo 
 
 Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighborhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.
 We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.
 Workplace & Benefits 
 At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time

 Du verbindest Daten aus verschiedenen Herstellerwelten und baust das Produkt selbst, mit AI als deinem Entwicklungsteam. Du spezifizierst, gestaltest, baust, bringst es live und betreibst es. Ein eigenes Entwicklungsteam gibt es für diese Rolle nicht, und es wird keines geben. Wer Tickets schreiben und übergeben will, ist hier falsch. 

 Wenn Du daran Spaß hast das Service Cockpit gemeinsam mit unseren Techniker:innen  von der Discovery bis zum Betrieb aufzubauen , den intern getesteten Read-only-Prototypen in kurzen Zyklen zu einer stabilen Produktivanwendung weiterzuentwickeln und die technische Basis selbst festzulegen 
 ein  kanonisches Datenmodell  für unsere eigene Wärmepumpenplattform sowie die Systeme von Buderus und LG zu definieren und mit unserem Datenteam umzusetzen 
 fehlende Messwerte, unklare Fehlercodes, technische Datenlücken und fehlende Zugänge  mit Analytics, HEMS, Platform, IT, Security und den Herstellern zu klären 
 sichere Schreibzugriffe  für ausgewählte Einstellungen zu bauen, Rollen und Berechtigungen abzustimmen und  wiederkehrende Wartungsaufgaben aus der Ferne zu automatisieren 
 am echten Fall mit unseren Techniker:innen zu arbeiten,  vermiedene Anfahrten und die First-Time-Fix-Rate zu messen  und die Plattform danach auszubauen: mit Kundenreporting, Predictive Maintenance gemeinsam mit unserem Data-Science-Team, weiteren Assetklassen, einer nativen App und der Anbindung an unsere Serviceprozesse 
 

 Und Dich hier wiedererkennst Erfahrung & Ownership:  Du bringst  mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung  im digitalen Produktmanagement, in Product Engineering oder mit Datenprodukten mit. Du hast Produkte selbst bis in den produktiven Einsatz gebracht, Verantwortung für ein unfertiges Produkt übernommen, eigene Prioritäten gesetzt und gemessen, ob deine Lösung im Alltag tatsächlich etwas verbessert.

 Datenverständnis:  Du kannst dich in unbekannte  Sensor-, Zeitreihen- und API-Daten  einarbeiten, Zusammenhänge erkennen und benennen, welche Werte oder Zugänge fehlen.  SQL und BI-Tools  gehören zu deinem Arbeitsalltag. Du musst nicht jedes Datenproblem allein lösen. Du löst es mit  AI, unserem Datenteam und Tech  und weißt, was du dort anfordern musst. 
 Produkturteil:  Du entwickelst professionelle Oberflächen für Menschen, die unter Zeitdruck arbeiten. Deine Entscheidungen leitest du aus den Aufgaben der Techniker:innen ab, nicht aus den Feldern, die ein System zufällig liefert. 
 Schnittstellenarbeit:  Du hast Daten oder Zugänge von Herstellern, Dienstleistern oder internen Plattformteams beschafft und dabei auch bei Widerständen den Überblick behalten.

jobs.title: Sr Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Product Marketing turns Chainalysis innovation into customer value. We position our intelligence as solutions customers can understand and consume through our platform, shape how we commercialize them, and give GTM the stories and strategic assets to win.
Financial services is a priority growth segment for Chainalysis, including banks, payments companies, fintechs, and other financial institutions. As digital assets become more connected to the financial system, these organizations face new opportunities, regulatory obligations, and financial-crime risks. This role makes the value of Chainalysis clear to the leaders responsible for navigating them.
 
 As Senior Product Marketing Manager for Financial Services, you will own how Chainalysis shows up in the market for these buyers. You will own and shape our intelligence, data, products, AI capabilities, and services into a differentiated customer story—one that connects to real workflows, urgent problems, and business outcomes.

 This is a role for a strong marketer and an exceptional writer. You can take a complex capability, a shifting market, or a fuzzy customer problem and shape it into a sharp point of view, a persuasive narrative, and practical tools that sellers and customers actually use. You will work closely with Product, Sales, Marketing & Communications, subject-matter experts, and GTM Solutions & Readiness teams to make the story land in the market.
 
 What you’ll be doing 
 Position the value 
 Define and evolve the financial services value narrative: what Chainalysis enables, why it matters, and why we are meaningfully different.

 Build messaging for priority buyer and user personas across compliance, risk, anti-fraud, investigations, and business leadership.

 Create the narratives, proof points, and strategic assets that help sellers communicate differentiated value with conviction.

 Own financial-services competitive intelligence, translating market moves into clear offensive and defensive positioning for deal teams.

 
 Turn value into solutions 
 Partner with Product, R&D, Marketing & Communications, and subject-matter experts to translate innovation into compelling industry solutions, use cases, and sales plays.

 Lead go-to-market planning for launches, major releases, platform capabilities, and commercial offerings.

 Shape customer-facing value narratives for pricing, packaging, and commercial models, including business cases and ROI stories.

 Bring a customer lens to product and market decisions: explain not only what a capability does, but why a Chief Compliance Officer or Head of Financial Crime should care.

 
 Win and learn in market 
 Produce the strategic content that moves financial-services opportunities forward: first-call decks, solution briefs, talk tracks, discovery frameworks, proof points, and sales plays.

 Partner with GTM Solutions & Readiness to scale the strongest narratives into field tools and enablement.

 Bring customer, field, partner, and competitive insight back into the work — sharpening positioning, converting market evidence into credible stories, and building repeatable use cases.

 
 What you’ll bring:
 
 5–8 years in product, solutions, industry, or B2B enterprise technology marketing, with experience in financial services, fintech, payments, or related regulated industry.

 A demonstrated ability to build positioning and messaging that changes how customers and sellers see a problem—not simply content that fills a library.

 Exceptional writing and editorial judgment. You can write crisp headlines, persuasive narratives, practical sales content, and executive-level messaging; you know the difference between jargon and precision.

 Strong understanding of enterprise buying journeys and sales motions in regulated, risk-sensitive environments.

 The ability to connect technical capabilities to business and operational value for both executive buyers and hands-on users.

 A collaborative self-starter, comfortable working across R&D, Sales, technical and revenue teams, and senior leaders to drive ambiguous, multi-stakeholder work forward independently.

 
 Nice to have: 
 Experience with blockchain, digital assets, or crypto-native financial infrastructure.

 Experience marketing AI-powered products, data platforms, intelligence products, cybersecurity, or risk and compliance technology.

 Familiarity with consumption- or usage-based pricing and packaging.

 Experience marketing to financial institutions at a data, intelligence, security, or enterprise-software company.

 
 You’ll thrive here if: 
You can shape complexity into a story people remember and a sales conversation people can use. You write with precision, bring sound judgment to ambiguous problems, build for repeatability rather than one-off requests, and care about the quality of what reaches customers and the field.
 AI at Chainalysis 
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done

 Strong communication skills in German and English and enjoyment in working with different stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: privacy is a fundamental human right. Since then, we've built the world's largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar — tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. In some situations, Proton has literally helped save lives.

We are profitable, independent (no VC control), and selectively hire from the top ~1% of applicants. Our 700+ team members across 50+ countries come from leading organizations and elite academic backgrounds. We move fast, keep hierarchy light, and prioritize impact over optics. If you want to do meaningful work with exceptionally high-caliber people, this is it. Check our open-source projects here.

The Role

We're building something new at Proton and we're hiring a Senior PM to lead it from the front.

This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, community dynamics, and Proton's mission to give people back control over their digital lives. You'll own the roadmap and execution for a product that brings privacy-first community experiences to millions of users. The team is small and senior; the scope is large. You’ll turn an ambitious product direction into clear strategy, crisp requirements, shipped experiences, and measurable outcomes.

We're looking for someone who has lived inside communities products: who understands how engagement compounds, why moderation decisions shape culture, and how trust is built (and destroyed) at scale. If you've helped build or grow a platform where users interact, organize, and belong and you want to do it in a way that doesn't exploit the people using it, this is the role.

What You'll Own

  • Define and drive the product strategy and roadmap end-to-end — from first principles through to shipped features — without waiting for direction from above
  • Own the metrics that matter: activation, engagement, retention, and community health. Set the targets, instrument the product to track them, and course-correct fast when signals shift
  • Translate deep knowledge of how online communities work — growth loops, moderation, network effects, content dynamics — into a clear product point of view and a prioritized execution plan
  • Lead cross-functional execution across a team of 6–12 engineers plus design, data, and growth — maintain velocity, surface blockers early, and keep the team focused on outcomes over activity
  • Drive structured discovery: user research, competitive analysis, and direct feedback loops that keep product decisions grounded in real behaviour, not assumptions
  • Represent the product externally when needed — to users, partners, and internal leadership — with clarity and confidence

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent on a social, messaging, or community platform
  • Deep understanding of community product mechanics — you can reason clearly about engagement loops, content moderation trade-offs, trust and safety, and network effects without needing it explained
  • Analytically sharp: you define success in numbers, run structured experiments, and make data-informed calls without losing sight of user intuition
  • Strong, direct communicator — you write and speak with precision, push back when something doesn't make sense, and keep stakeholders aligned without over-meeting
  • Proven ability to lead a product autonomously: you identify the right problem, build the case, and drive it to shipped — without a roadmap handed to you

Nice to Have

  • Experience building privacy-respecting alternatives to mainstream social or community platforms

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey – from service, to sales, to ecommerce. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams including engineering, sales, and marketing to develop product strategies that align with our customer needs and business objectives. This role requires a blend of technical knowledge and business acumen, enabling you to drive product decisions and ensure customer success in highly technical environments.

 Work closely with senior leadership and engineering teams to define product strategies, ensuring alignment with CesiumAstro’s business objectives and customer needs. 

 Contribute to the development of product roadmaps, prioritizing features and enhancements based on market trends, customer feedback, and technological advancements. 

 Act as a liaison between product engineering, business development/sales, marketing, and customer support teams to deliver products that meet or exceed customer expectations. 

 Facilitate clear communication and collaboration across teams to drive product development cycles. 

 Engage directly with customers to understand their technical needs, challenges, and goals. Leverage this insight to inform product decisions and ensure that solutions meet customer expectations. 

 Oversee the launch of new products and features, working with the marketing team to drive product adoption and customer satisfaction. 

 Provide technical leadership and customer-facing support as needed to ensure smooth product integrations. 

 Lead the identification and implementation of continuous improvements for products and processes, ensuring that CesiumAstro’s products remain industry-leading and meet the evolving demands of our customers. 

 Create and maintain high-quality documentation, including user manuals, application notes, and white papers. 

 Ensure that customer-facing teams are well-equipped with the knowledge to support product offerings. 

 JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS 

 Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in a relevant technical field such as Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, or related discipline. 

 At least 7 years of experience in the design of communication electronics, technical product development, product management, or application support. 

 In-depth understanding of RF electronics, communication systems, and associated technologies such as digital systems, embedded software, FPGAs, and power electronics. 

 Proven experience working with technical customers, developing strong relationships, and translating their needs into actionable product requirements. 

 Working knowledge of programming languages such as C/C++ or Python. 

 Exceptional troubleshooting skills and ability to understand, diagnose, and solve complex product issues across hardware and software domains. 

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. 

 Experience with high-reliability electronics and systems, particularly in the aerospace industry.

 PREFERRED EXPERIENCE 

 Background in technical sales, marketing, or customer solution development is a plus.

Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick. 
 

 About us 
 

 Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable. 
 

 Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry-first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices . With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels , including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search. 
 

 We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic . We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst , and trusted by 2000+ customers from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino's, and the list goes on. 
 

 Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it — see for yourself . We consistently outperform and continue our leadership, and the results speak for themselves . 
 

 From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world-class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables , our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM. 
 

 Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading. 
 

 

 We are looking for a Product Manager who wants to make the dream a reality. 

 

 What is our mission? 

 

 We are visionaries who guide new product ideas. We are setting the vision for our growing family of products. We use data, research, strategy, and empathy to guide development and design teams toward a common goal since we believe that only our products can alter Insider One`s destiny. We are Insider One’s innovators, our impact starts on day one, and our mission is to prove that break-through products can be created outside Silicon Valley.

 

 What are we offering? 

 

 Impact ; be a part of a world-class product team where we constantly get challenged with new things and the results of our actions create an impact for hundreds of millions of users every day.

 Experience ; get important responsibilities, learn from your mistakes without getting blamed, watch experienced people work on complex matters, gain one of the most important things to become a great product manager, experience.

 Delight ; make tough decisions, release new features, create innovating products which bring ease and joy to the life of many individuals who use them.

 Community ; surround yourself with great people who constantly help each other and push each other to be better, join many different events, and become a part of the Insider One Community.

 

 What are we searching for? 

 

 Leadership , you can make decisions and set direction while motivating and inspiring people around you to follow you in that direction.

 Communication , you serve as the diplomat of the team, you can transmit complex information to different audiences clearly and you are talented in reaching the information you need on the people you are talking to.

Overview:

We are looking for a Product Manager to support the build, rollout, adoption, and continuous improvement of AI-powered products used across Guidepoint’s expert-network operations.

This role sits at the intersection of product management, product operations, workflow automation, AI adoption, and internal tools. The ideal candidate is a hands-on problem solver who can work closely with users, engineering, QA, design, operations, and leadership to turn high-friction workflows into reliable, scalable product systems.

The Product Manager will support a portfolio of mature and emerging initiatives by writing clear requirements, managing user feedback, looking at adoption, usage data & analytics, triaging issues, supporting UAT and helping teams make data-driven product improvements. This role is especially important as Guidepoint expands its use of AI, automation, and human-in-the-loop workflows across complex operational processes.

Product Delivery & Execution

  • Support rollout planning, user onboarding, training, and adoption follow-ups for new and existing product capabilities.

Product Operations & Workflow Support

  • Act as a day-to-day product contact for users
  • Triage bug reports, user questions, change requests, and product feedback.
  • Translate recurring themes into clear product requirements, tickets, acceptance criteria, and follow-up actions.

AI Workflows & Tools

Metrics, Adoption & Continuous Improvement

  • Support quarterly and sprint-level planning by bringing structured insights on product performance, adoption gaps, and user pain points.

Cross-Functional Communication

We operate at the intersection of advanced cloud infrastructure, artificial intelligence, and applied data science, transforming how complex industrial products - such as automotive systems, aircraft, robotics, advanced manufacturing systems, and batteries - are conceived, tested, and developed.

We're rebuilding the platform from the ground up, so you'll shape the product from day one. You'll drive execution across Research, Data Science, Engineering, and Forward Deployed Engineering to ship capabilities spanning agentic experiences, applied AI workflows, and enterprise integrations. You will work closely with enterprise customers to understand complex engineering and industrial workflows, identify where emerging AI technologies can create meaningful value, turn field signals into scalable platform improvements, and mentor other product managers across the organisation while setting a high bar for technical depth, product judgement, and customer empathy.

  • Deep customer empathy with a curiosity for understanding complex engineering and industrial workflows, diagnosing friction points, and identifying where new technologies can fundamentally improve how customers work.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Applied Physical AI
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.
 
We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

 

What You'll Do:

CoreWeave’s Physical AI team builds the essential cloud platform for AI innovators, applying machine learning to solve previously intractable physics and engineering challenges. We operate at the intersection of advanced cloud infrastructure, artificial intelligence, and applied data science to transform how complex industrial products and systems are conceived, tested, and developed.

About the role: 

As a Staff Product Manager, you will own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and end-to-end delivery for products within CoreWeave’s Physical AI portfolio. Your primary focus will be data-centre design: replacing manual, spreadsheet-driven processes with dependable internal products that convert power budgets into rack-and-pod layouts, cabling, and physical floor plans. In this role, you will conduct field discovery with data-centre engineers, translate tacit domain expertise into explicit parametric rules, and sequence product rollout from logical sizing to physical layout optimization. Additionally, you will utilize AI-assisted prototyping tools directly, validate product accuracy against completed site data, align cross-functional stakeholders across Engineering and Research, and evaluate future expansion opportunities across the Physical AI ecosystem.

Who You Are:

  • Significant professional experience in product management, product strategy, technical programme leadership, or related roles, with a track record of driving complex technologies from initial concept through broad adoption.
  • Proven ability to navigate ambiguous, technically complex domains, owning end-to-end problem definition, business case formulation, prototyping, and user adoption.
  • Technical fluency across infrastructure domains (e.g., networking, power, systems engineering) with demonstrated ability to translate tacit expert knowledge into formal parameters, constraints, and generative logic.
  • Hands-on familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and coding literacy sufficient to read, shape, and test prototype outputs.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills with experience aligning Product, Engineering, Research, Data Science, and operational teams around shared priorities.
  • Deep user empathy and a data-driven approach to measuring product outcomes, time savings, and capex impact against real-world metrics.

Preferred:

  • Academic or professional background in engineering, physical research, data-centre design, networking, High-Performance Computing (HPC), or related industrial fields.
  • Experience with parametric design, optimization algorithms, operations research, placement/routing logic, or combinatorial search.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure platforms, 2D/3D CAD representations, or frontend/JavaScript visualization frameworks.

Wondering if you're a good fit? 

We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams—even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we've found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we'd love to talk.

  • You love to build clarity out of complexity and champion high-impact technical products from concept through adoption.
  • You're curious about how AI, automation, and rules-driven design can transform real-world infrastructure and engineering workflows.

jobs.title: Senior Product Design Manager, Enterprise
jobs.description:
About Scale AI

Scale AI accelerates the development and deployment of AI, from the high-quality training data and evaluation services that power the world's leading AI labs, to full-stack AI applications built for Enterprise, U.S. Public Sector, and Global Public Sector customers. We don't just hand over a model; we find the highest-value use case, build the system around it, and own the outcome, whether that's an agent supporting mission planning for the Department of Defense, a sovereign AI platform for a government ministry, or an agentic workflow inside a Fortune 500 enterprise. Our platform powers breakthroughs at the frontier of AI, and great design is how we make that power accessible, intuitive, and trusted by the teams who rely on it every day.

The Role

We're looking for a product design leader to lead and grow our enterprise team.

What You'll Do

  • Set the direction for Enterprise design. Define what exceptional design looks like for Scale's Applications customers making high-stakes decisions and for the expert contributors powering the platform. Translate the broader design vision into a clear, motivating direction for your team.
  • Build and lead the team. Own hiring, development, and day-to-day leadership for a growing team of designers. Create the culture and operating rhythms that let them do their best work.
  • Drive design execution across the Enterprise product. Partner with your Product and Engineering counterparts to set priorities and ensure design is involved from problem scoping through delivery, not brought in at the end.
  • Raise the craft bar. Uphold design principles and quality standards on your team. Push designers beyond digitizing workflows toward genuinely rethinking how people work with AI. Hold the line on quality without slowing delivery.
  • Contribute to the design system. Help shape and adopt Scale's shared design system, championing consistent component use and contributing patterns back so a distributed team can build coherently at speed.
  • Ground the team in user needs. Build the research habits and cadences that keep your team's decisions rooted in what enterprise customers and users actually need, and advocate for that discipline with your Product and Engineering partners.
  • Shape Scale's approach to human-agent interaction. Scale's core value is human-in-the-loop AI, and the interface is where trust is built or lost. Help define the interaction patterns for how enterprise users work alongside AI agents, and contribute to Scale's growing point of view on this emerging space.

Who you are

  • 3+ years managing product design teams
  • Proven track record of simplifying data-dense, power-user workflows into elegant solutions for B2B and beyond
  • Deeply customer-centric, with a track record of grounding design decisions in real user needs and business impact
  • Fluent in how AI is changing design practice and tooling; building AI-native workflows for your team
  • Experience designing for agentic platforms, and excited to shape the future of interaction patterns for AI and human-in-the-loop systems
  • Balance speed and quality; you know how to prioritize ruthlessly and get the team shipping without dropping the craft bar
  • Excellent communicator. You can present to a leaders and a front-line PM and make both feel heard

 

PLEASE NOTE: Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants.

About Us:

At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications.

We believe that everyone should be able to bring their whole selves to work, which is why we are proud to be an inclusive and equal opportunity workplace. HEADLINE:

Reporting to: Chief Product & Technology Officer
London - Hybrid-Working: 3 days in office, 2 days from home

 ABOUT THE ROLE: 
 Are you passionate about using data, technology, and payments expertise to drive tangible customer value?
 We’re looking for an experienced and commercially minded Head of Product to lead the evolution of our optimisation and orchestration products, scaling them to the next level. 
 You’ll operate at the intersection of Product, Data Science, and Commercial teams, translating analytical insights into measurable business outcomes for our customers and for APEXX. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys connecting complex technical capabilities with commercial value, inspiring cross-functional alignment, and ensuring optimisation becomes a core growth driver for the company.
 If you thrive on solving complex payment challenges, shaping intelligent optimisation products, and communicating value with clarity and conviction, we’d love to hear from you.

 WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING: 
 Product Strategy & Commercial Ownership 
 Define and drive the long-term strategy and roadmap for APEXX’s Optimisation and Orchestration suite, ensuring clear differentiation and customer value.

 Establish the commercial framework for optimisation, working with Finance, Sales, and Marketing to design value-based pricing models .

 Lead the evolution of optimisation from a capability into a scalable product line, influencing its positioning, packaging, and monetisation.

 Provide thought leadership across the organisation on the role of AI and data-driven optimisation in payments.

 Cross-Functional Collaboration & Delivery 
 Partner with Engineering and Data Science to develop AI/ML-powered optimisation features that improve authorisation, reduce cost, and drive measurable performance gains.

 Work closely with Sales , Relationship Management , and Marketing teams to articulate product value and support commercial success across the portfolio.

 Drive alignment across teams, ensuring strategic intent translates into customer-ready, high-impact product delivery.

 Customer Value, Growth & Commercial Enablement 
 Translate model performance and analytical insights into ROI-focused, commercially compelling narratives for customers and internal stakeholders.

 Enable Sales and Relationship Managers to position and sell optimisation as a premium, value-generating product.

 Be the Subject matter expert on Interchange and Scheme fee pricing and optimisation opportunities.

 Partner with customers to identify where data, AI, and automation can unlock incremental efficiency, acceptance rates, or cost reduction.

 Contribute directly to upsell and cross-sell opportunities, helping turn product performance into revenue growth.

 Product Excellence & Evidence Driven Decision Making 
 Define success metrics, experimentation frameworks, and governance around optimisation performance.

 Promote strong product management discipline - discovery, validation, delivery, and measurement — across optimisation workstreams.

 Use data and evidence to balance strategic ambition with operational focus, ensuring decisions are measurable and outcomes are sustainable.

 ABOUT YOU: 
 You've done this before: You have demonstrable experience in Product Management , with a proven record of leading and scaling complex, data-driven products with clear commercial outcomes.

 You're commercially driven: Commercially astute, able to craft value propositions and communicate financial impact confidently to senior and external audiences.

 You're an influencer: Natural influencer who can inspire cross-functional teams and align stakeholders around a common product vision.

 You think big picture: Strategic yet hands-on, capable of operating at both portfolio and execution level in a fast-moving environment.

 GREAT TO HAVE: 
 You have domain knowledge: You have Deep understanding of payment transaction lifecycle , including authorisation, authentication (3DS), settlement, fraud, chargebacks, interchange and scheme fees. 

 WHY JOIN US: 
 You’ll help shape the future of payments optimisation at APEXX building products that directly impact merchant performance and profitability. You’ll work with talented teams across product, data, and engineering, driving measurable improvements in one of the most dynamic spaces in FinTech.
 You’ll have the opportunity to shape the strategic direction of optimisation products and influence product management practices across the team.

 COMPENSATION & BENEFITS: 
Great people deserve great rewards. We believe in recognising the impact you make with competitive compensation and benefits that support you both at work and beyond.
 Whether it's taking time to recharge, looking after your health, working from somewhere new, or investing in your growth, we've built a benefits package designed to help you thrive, because when our people do well, so does APEXX.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager, Integrations
jobs.description:
Who we are
 Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.
 We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi . The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.
 We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter , Noah Hollmann , and Sauraj Gambhir , and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.
 In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.
 
 The role 
 Most enterprises will never call our API directly. They will meet TabPFN inside the platforms they already run: SAP, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Databricks, or their own cloud. How well that works, how fast each release arrives there, and which platforms come next is the job of our Technical Product Manager for Integrations.
 You take each model release from handover to live across every channel, working with the engineers who build the model and the partner teams who host it. Inside SAP you carry the product side of TabPFN across its platforms, from AI Core to SAP Analytics Cloud, and you help build the integration engineering team that will work with you. Several decisions are yours to bring to the table: which announced channels we build next, what a marketplace listing should cost, how support for all of this works.
 You work directly with our product team, our engineers and the founders, and you report to the CTO. This suits someone who enjoys landing things on a date as much as deciding what to build, and who still likes being close to the code.
 What you'll do 
 Take every model release live across SAP, the cloud marketplaces and customer environments, on a plan you build with product and engineering.

 Be the technical counterpart for the partner teams that host TabPFN, from SAP's platform teams to the hyperscaler marketplaces.

 Shape how TabPFN shows up inside SAP's stack and what the integration engineering team builds first.

 Bring the open channel decisions to the founders with a recommendation, and stay hands-on: listings, docs, smoke tests, a PR when it is faster than asking.

 What we're looking for 
 Two or more years as product manager for a platform or integration surface: a product that ships into partners' platforms, or that other companies build on.

 You have shipped through gates you did not control, landed multi-team releases on dates, and made a large enterprise's process work for a small, fast team.

 You started as an engineer and never fully stopped: you read code, logs and scan reports without a translator.

 You are in Berlin or ready to relocate; Freiburg or New York can work.

 What sets you apart 
 You have shipped into an SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft or Oracle ecosystem, or know the cloud marketplaces from the inside.

 You have deployed machine learning models and know what GPUs cost.

 You have worked at a startup, and you use AI tools to take real work off your plate.

 
 Life at Prior Labs
 You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right.
 Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together.
 
 Our Commitments
 The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are.
 We care about how your data is handled - see our Recruiting Data Privacy page

jobs.title: (Senior) Technical Project Manager Germany
jobs.description:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role:

As (Senior) Technical Project Manager, you will own the end-to-end delivery of high complexity Agentic AI deployments for enterprise customers, running your pod (TPM, Forward Deployed Engineer, Agent Architect) as a single accountable delivery unit from scoping through go-live and hypercare.

This is your opportunity to sit at the center of how global enterprise brands adopt Agentic AI, translating technical complexity into business outcomes for executive stakeholders at companies like Booking.com, SAP, and Allianz.

Areas of ownership:

  • Project Delivery: Own scope, schedule, budget, risk, and quality for assigned Agentic AI customer projects, selecting the right delivery methodology (Waterfall, Agile, or Hybrid) for each customer context.
  • Customer & Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary delivery contact for customer sponsors, IT, and business stakeholders, running governance calls, steering committees, UAT readouts, and go-live reviews.
  • Cross-Functional & Pod Coordination: Align Forward Deployed Engineers on integration readiness and Agent Architects on discovery and conversational design, while coordinating with Sales, Solution Engineering, Product, and Support across the customer journey.
  • Methodology & Process Discipline: Facilitate sprints and retros or lead stage-gate reviews depending on methodology, and enforce documentation standards across charters, design docs, runbooks, and handovers.
  • Metrics & Reporting: Track deployment KPIs such as time to first agent in UAT and milestone on-time rate, and report delivery status and risk posture to internal and external stakeholders.

Who you are:

  • 2+ years of experience in technical program management, program management, or delivery management for SaaS or enterprise software
  • Hands-on experience delivering solutions in Contact Center/CCaaS, UCaaS, conversational AI, IVA/IVR, or related CX platforms
  • Solid grounding in Agile/Scrum, Hybrid, and Waterfall methodologies, with judgment on when to apply each
  • Proven track record managing multiple concurrent projects with global, distributed teams
  • Fluent in English and German

Our recruiting process:

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview → Bar Raiser

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager Claims (w/m/d/x)
jobs.description:
DEINE ROLLE Im Schadenfall entscheidet sich, ob ein Versicherer sein Leistungsversprechen hält. Als  Senior Product Manager Claims (w/m/d/x)  übernimmst du End-to-End-Verantwortung für einen strategischen Kernbereich der EMIL Insurance Suite und gestaltest, wie Versicherer Schäden digital, automatisiert und kundenfreundlich abwickeln, von der Meldung bis zur Auszahlung. Wenn du ein Produkt strategisch und operativ aufs nächste Level heben willst, ist das deine Rolle. 

 WAS DICH ERWARTET Entwickle eine klare Vision und priorisierte Roadmap für den Claims-Bereich und treibe als Motor den Produkterfolg voran, von der Schadenmeldung (FNOL) bis zur Auszahlung. 

 Gestalte die Automatisierung des Schadenprozesses: regelbasierte und KI-gestützte Schadenprüfung, Dunkelverarbeitung und effiziente Workflows bis zur Regulierung und Auszahlung.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Data APIs)
jobs.description:
About 9fin 
 9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.
 Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.
 Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.
 We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.
 
 The Opportunity 
  
 9fin has built one of the most comprehensive datasets in credit and debt markets: news, financials, cap tables, instrument data, legal documents, and ESG analysis. Today, most clients access that data through 9fin.com . But a large and growing segment of the market wants to consume our data programmatically to power firm-level workflows at scale: a negative news signal triggers an automated credit review, updated financials trigger a portfolio rebalance, a covenant keyword triggers a sanctions flag.
  
 These buyers (quant desks, data engineering teams, systematic investors, risk and compliance functions) will never log into a web application. They need APIs, data feeds, and cloud-native delivery through platforms like Snowflake. At comparable financial data providers, this distribution channel represents 20-30% of total revenue. 9fin is at the beginning of this journey.
  
 The challenge is to turn 9fin's integrated dataset into a portfolio of standalone data products with a coherent commercial strategy. You will define how the data gets packaged (what goes together, what stands alone, how it's tiered and priced), the order in which products go to market, and the commercial models that fit each buyer segment: quant desks, data engineering teams, risk and compliance functions, and systematic investors. You will work in lockstep with the Head of Pre-Sales, who owns technical validation and deal execution, to ensure that what you build maps to how these buyers actually evaluate and procure data. The first candidates pan news content, financials and cap tables, instrument data, and legal data (complex, high-value, and genuinely unsolved at the data representation layer).
  
 You will work cross-functionally across our platform teams, analytics engineering, and the domain squads that own the underlying datasets. You will also work closely with Sales to support a fundamentally different GTM motion: solution-selling with partner clients, joint POCs, multi-stakeholder deals, and usage-based commercial models rather than seat-based subscriptions.
  
 This is a 0-to-1 build. If you have built API or data products before and want to do it again in a market where the opportunity is wide open, this is it.
  
  
 What You'll Do 
  
 Product Strategy & Execution 
 Define the product vision and strategy for 9fin's external data distribution: APIs, data shares, and future delivery mechanisms (cloud sync, pub/sub).

 Own the data catalogue decisions: which datasets to expose, in what format, through which channels, and in what order, balancing client demand, data readiness, and commercial potential

 Design the developer experience end-to-end: API design, documentation, developer portal, sandbox/playground, error handling, rate limiting, and versioning

 Work with analytics engineering and domain teams to define schemas, data models, and transformation logic that make 9fin's data consumable and valuable outside the application

 Use a partner model to validate early: select and work closely with 1-2 clients during development to co-develop and prove out each data product before broader launch

 Shape the commercial model for API products: packaging, tiering, usage-based pricing, distribution controls, and entitlement structures that capture the value of programmatic data access

  
 Data Quality, Infrastructure & Compliance 
  
 Partner with the Head of Analytics to ensure data products meet the reliability, freshness, and accuracy standards that enterprise clients building automated systems expect

 Define SLAs for data delivery (latency, uptime, completeness) and build the monitoring and metering infrastructure to back them up

 Own the entitlements and access control layer: ensuring the right clients can access the right data under the right contractual terms, with appropriate usage limits and controls

 Work with Legal to define data usage policies, including restrictions on redistribution, AI training and model embedding, and onward use, protecting 9fin's data IP while enabling legitimate client workflows

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager – Software Development (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Your mission You are responsible for the operational management of our software development and ensure that our Backend and Frontend teams can deliver reliably and with clear focus. You manage planning, capacities, dependencies, and releases and keep the entire development process in view.
 You lead our Development Leads and development teams both functionally and disciplinarily. You establish clear responsibilities, develop team members, and ensure that problems and blockers are identified and resolved early.
 You coordinate teams and tickets throughout their full lifecycle, continuously improve our development and project processes, and ensure transparent and realistic planning for all relevant stakeholders.
 You are the central interface between Engineering and Product Management. Product owns product strategy, prioritization, and requirements; together with the Development Leads, you ensure these are translated into technically sound, realistically planned, and reliably delivered solutions.
 This is not a traditional IT project management role: you bring a strong technical background yourself and can make architecture and design decisions together with our Development Leads, assess technical risks, and evaluate different solution approaches.
 Alongside short-term delivery, you also keep long-term technical topics in view, including architecture, maintainability, security, technical debt, and the continuous improvement of our engineering standards.
 You actively drive our AI First Development Culture. This goes far beyond AI-assisted coding: you identify opportunities to integrate AI into research, technical conception, architecture, project planning, development, testing, reviews, debugging, documentation, and other development processes, and help the team use these tools effectively.
 

 Your profile You have at least 5 years of relevant professional experience in or around software development and have worked hands-on as a software developer yourself.
 You bring proven experience leading developers and development teams and have already held both functional and disciplinary leadership responsibility.
 You have experience managing software development projects: you have coordinated multiple developers and stakeholders, owned planning and timelines, managed dependencies, and guided releases through to delivery.
 You are technically deep enough to understand and shape architecture decisions, identify technical risks early, and discuss technical topics with experienced developers at eye level.
 You bring strong experience in at least one of our technology areas: Python-based backend development, ideally with Django / Django REST Framework or FastAPI, or modern frontend development with React and TypeScript. Experience with the other area is a plus.
 You understand modern SaaS architectures, REST APIs, relational databases, and the core challenges involved in developing, operating, and evolving complex web applications.
 You can balance product requirements, technical possibilities, and available resources and communicate decisions transparently and convincingly.
 You already use AI tools actively or are deeply engaged with how AI can change development and project processes. You evaluate new tools pragmatically, critically assess their output, and can establish successful workflows across the team.
 You communicate clearly and convincingly and are equally comfortable coordinating with Engineering, Product Management, and senior management.
 You bring a collaborative leadership style, strong organizational skills, and a genuine desire to shape and improve how we work.
 You are fluent in German and English.
 In addition to working from home, you value in-person exchange with colleagues and the sense of being part of a team.
 

 Why us? At Athereon GRC, we develop smart software that advances companies, organizations, and institutions across the private sector, public sector, and social services in the areas of information security and compliance. As an agile and fast-growing company, we combine technological excellence with a genuine hands-on mentality – here, your contribution truly matters.
 Bring your expertise and personality to our team – we're looking for people who are passionate about IT, think outside the box, and are eager to take on responsibility.

jobs.title: Product Lead @Panora
jobs.description:
🚀 Why this role 
 Panora is building the AI platform that will redefine how insurance brokers work across Europe.
 The problem is structural: brokers spend the majority of their time on repetitive, manual tasks (switching between carrier portals, chasing documents, re-entering data) instead of advising clients. The result? Underinsured businesses, frustrated brokers, and a profession stuck in the past.
 We believe AI can fix this. Not by replacing brokers, but by giving every broker the capabilities of the best one in the room: on every case, at every critical moment. That's the vision we've been pitching to VCs. That's what we're building.
 Panora has live product, first paying customers, and a roadmap far bigger than our current team. The foundations are solid, built with Hexa's support, with strong technical and product groundwork already in place. Now we need someone to take ownership of that vision and turn it into a product brokers love.
 You'll be our first Product hire. You won't just manage a backlog, you'll shape how an entire industry modernizes. You'll own the roadmap, build the product function from scratch, and make sure every feature we ship moves us closer to a world where no one is underinsured.

 🎯 Your mission 
 Take Panora's product from "it works" to "it's the reference": structure discovery, relentlessly prioritize, and quickly scope the features that unlock adoption and retention among brokerage firms.

 📋 What you'll do
 Discovery: understand, explore, prototype 
 Field discovery: spend time with brokers (demos, calls, on-site visits) to understand their day-to-day quoting workflow and spot the real friction points, not surface-level requests.

 Insurance domain interface: translate the constraints of brokerage and carriers (products, quoting rules, regulation) into product decisions.

 Product design: frame flows and screens (with engineering support), keeping a high bar on simplicity for non-technical users.

 Delivery: prioritize, spec, ship 
 Roadmap & prioritization with founders: build and continuously arbitrate the product roadmap, make trade-offs between business impact, technical debt and speed, and say no.

 Specs & delivery: write clear specs, scope work with engineers, and drive delivery end to end through to production.

 Product voice internally: align sales and ops on the "what" and the "why," bridging customer needs and what we build. Own the weekly product meeting.

 Data & impact: instrument, measure usage (activation, retention, feature adoption via PostHog) and close the loop between product decisions and results.

 Quality: make the AI trustworthy 
 AI agentic workflows: design and iterate on the AI agents at Panora's core (multi-carrier quoting, document generation, compliance checks). You define what the agent does, how it handles edge cases, and where the human stays in the loop. You work closely with engineering to tune prompts, evaluate outputs, and push coverage.

 AI feedback loop: build the instrumentation that makes AI outputs improvable: capture broker corrections, flag low-confidence outputs, and turn real-world usage into a continuous improvement cycle. You own the gap between "AI generates" and "broker trusts."
 

 ✅ What we're looking for 
 4-6 years of product experience, including at least one role in a B2B SaaS environment with real roadmap ownership.

 You've already driven a product end to end : discovery → specs → delivery → impact measurement, autonomously.

 Excellent prioritization and trade-off skills: you know how to focus a small team on what matters.

 Analytical rigor: you make decisions with data, not gut feel alone.

 Crystal-clear communication, written and spoken, with both technical AND non-technical audiences (customers, founders).

 Experience with AI / automation-driven products.

 Strong appetite for a complex, regulated domain : insurance doesn't scare you, it interests you.

 You're comfortable with early-stage velocity and move forward without being told how.
 

 ➕ Bonus 
 Knowledge of insurance, brokerage, or fintech/insurtech.

 Design sensibility (Figma) and the ability to produce your own prototypes/ASCII.

 You've already been a company's first product hire or built a product function from scratch.

 💡 Your first 90 days 
 30 days: full immersion : you master the product, the brokerage market and the quoting workflow; you've spoken with 10+ customers/prospects and mapped the friction points.

 60 days: you've taken ownership of the roadmap, set up a simple prioritization process, and shipped a first improvement with measurable impact.

 90 days: you're Panora's product point of reference : the quarterly roadmap is scoped, instrumented, and aligned with sales and founders.

 Chez Thiga, nous sommes convaincus que l’IA ne transforme pas seulement les produits, mais aussi la façon de les concevoir, de les construire et de les faire évoluer. Discovery, delivery, coordination, documentation, pilotage : tout le Product Development Lifecycle est en train d’être réinventé. 

 La plupart des entreprises ont déjà démarré. Elles ont des POCs, des power users, des outils partout, parfois des gains individuels visibles. Mais elles peinent encore à transformer cette énergie en gain collectif , en nouveaux standards de travail et en performance durable . 

 C’est là qu’intervient l’ AI Product Ops . 

 Pas pour agir comme théoricien, mais pour repenser concrètement les modes de fonctionnement produit-tech, designer des équipes hybrides humains-agents, outiller les bons workflows, et faire de l’IA un levier d’efficience organisationnelle dans le delivery de produits digitaux. 

 Chez Thiga, nous ne nous arrêtons pas à la recommandation. Nous construisons avec nos clients. Nous testons, nous outillons, nous faisons adopter. 

 Le job 

 En immersion chez le client, tu interviens au cœur de l’organisation produit-tech pour refondre le Product Development Lifecycle avec l’IA . 

 Ton rôle : identifier où l’IA crée le plus de valeur, repenser les processus, faire émerger de nouveaux standards de travail, et construire les premiers outils, skills ou agents qui rendent cette transformation réelle. 

 Tu es à la fois :

 Reconcevoir des processus de travail plus simples, plus rapides et plus robustes, en intégrant nativement l’IA dans le fonctionnement des équipes.

 Contribuer au product building de manière très opérationnelle, pour démontrer par la preuve ce que de nouveaux modes de travail rendent possible. 

 

 
 Former et accompagner les équipes produit, design, tech et métier dans l’adoption de nouvelles pratiques, de nouveaux outils et de nouveaux réflexes de travail. 

 

 
 Mesurer l’impact des évolutions mises en place et ajuster en continu ce qui doit l’être. 

 

 
 Aider les clients à éviter trois écueils fréquents : beaucoup d’énergie pour peu d’impact, des POCs qui ne scalent pas, et des gains individuels qui ne se traduisent jamais en gains système. 

 

 
 À quoi ressemble le succès dans ce rôle 

 Au bout de quelques mois chez un client, tu as contribué à faire émerger des résultats visibles et mesurables :

 plusieurs agents ou assistants internes en production d’usage ; 

 

 
 une baisse nette du temps passé sur les tâches à faible valeur ; 

 

 
 une amélioration tangible de la rapidité d’exécution et de l’efficience collective. 

 

 
 la satisfaction des équipes accompagnées ; 

 

 
 Ce que ce rôle n’est pas 

 Ce poste n’est pas fait pour toi si tu cherches principalement à faire : 

 
 
 du conseil hors sol, très conceptuel, sans opérationnalisation rapide ; 

 

 
 du portfolio management ; 

 

 
 de la gestion d’infrastructure ou de plateforme ;
