 L’AI Product Ops n’est ni un PMO, ni un architecte de plateforme, ni un ML engineer. C’est un rôle à l’intersection de l’ efficience organisationnelle , du build , et de la conduite du changement . 

 Qui es-tu ? 

 Tu as au moins 6 ans d’expérience , avec un parcours qui t’a donné une compréhension forte du fonctionnement réel des équipes produit-tech.

 ou un·e Product Manager avec une très forte fibre ops ; 

 

 
 Et surtout : 

 
 
 Tu as déjà travaillé au sein d’équipes produit, au plus près du delivery et de la réalité terrain.

 Ta mission au quotidien : 
 

 Identifier et prioriser les besoins utilisateurs et business du client

 Définir la stratégie et roadmap du produit.

 Etablir une vision produit “claire” identifier les incertitudes et mettre en place les démarches pertinentes pour les lever

  • Drive Complex Engagements: Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, concurrent, enterprise-level customer projects from kickoff to sign-off within fast-paced environments.
  • Scope & Milestone Management: Prepare enterprise customers for deployment, establish clear success criteria, track deliverables, set targets, manage resources, and ensure project execution adheres to deadlines and budgets.
  • Risk & Issue Governance: Proactively identify, track, and mitigate project risks and technical dependencies, resolving issues autonomously before they escalate.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Serve as the single point of contact and escalation owner for customer executives, cross-functional internal teams (Engineering, Customer Support, Sales), and third-party partners.
  • Quality & Performance: Execute quality control throughout project lifecycles to ensure deliverables meet or exceed Rubrik's standards and customer business objectives.

2. PMO & Process Optimisation

  • Partner with PS leadership to help build, refine, and maintain the PMO governance framework, including standard operating procedures, project methodologies, and key performance indicators.
  • Continuous Improvement: Flag bottlenecks and recommend improvements that enhance operational efficiency, margins, and customer satisfaction.
  • Assist in establishing best practices for your engagements, resource allocation, utilisation tracking, and project health reporting across the PS portfolio.

Required Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of direct Project Management experience delivering customer-facing, enterprise technical projects within a Professional Services or Consulting organization.
  • Previous experience with managing customers from Financial Services, Government, Healthcare industries
  • Track record of managing multiple complex, high-visibility client engagements concurrently in a fast-paced technology environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, exercising strong judgment and decision-making in ambiguous, high-pressure customer situations.
  • Expert knowledge of modern project management tools (e.g., Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence, Asana) as well as Google Workspace.
  • Fluent written and spoken French and English skills is must.
  • Exceptional executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills.

Good to Have Qualifications:

  • Recognised credentials like Project Management Professional (PMP), PRINCE2, knowledge of Agile/Scrum (CSM, PMI-ACP), or Lean frameworks.
  • Technical Background: Prior hands-on experience or foundational knowledge in Data Management, Cloud Infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP), Data Protection, Enterprise Storage, Cybersecurity, or SaaS delivery is a strong plus.
  • Financial acumen regarding professional services metrics (e.g., revenue recognition, margin, utilisation, project profitability).
  • Experience contributing to PMO governance practices.

jobs.title: Senior Lead Product Strategy (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Gesundheitsversorgung der Zukunft

Als Senior Lead Product Strategy im Medics Cluster arbeitest Du direkt mit, den größten Produktlaunch von Doctolib in Deutschland zu skalieren: Die All-In-One Praxissoftware, mit der Gesundheitsteams Ende zu Ende alle administrativen und klinischen Arbeitsabläufe vor, während und nach dem Termin steuern können. 
Als Teil unseres lokalen Product Marketing Teams handelst Du wie ein CEO für Deinen Bereich: Du entwickelst die Go-to-Market-Strategie in Deutschland weiter und bist verantwortlich für deren erfolgreiche Umsetzung. Dein Hauptziel ist es, durch innovative Marktstrategien die Ziele für ongeboardete Praxen zu erreichen und die Zufriedenheit unserer Nutzer weiter zu erhöhen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst und setzt Go-to-Market-Strategien für Doctolib’s Produkt- und Feature-Launches um
  • Als Stimme unserer Nutzer verbesserst Du kontinuierlich unseren Product-Market-Fit und gestaltest unsere Product Roadmap
  • Gleichzeitig stellt Du sicher, dass wir die Signale unsere Nutzer entlang der Customer Journey verstehen und darauf aufbauend kontinuierlich unsere Value Delivery, Usage, Trust und Customer Experience verbessern
  • Du analysierst Markttrends und die Wettbewerbslandschaft, um strategische Chancen zu identifizieren
  • Du definierst die Produktpositionierung und -botschaften für den deutschen Markt
  • Du arbeitest eng mit den Teams Marketing, Sales, Customer Success sowie Product & Tech zusammen
  • Du managst Feature Releases und stellst deren erfolgreiche Markteinführung sicher
  • Gemeinsam mit anderen Teams verfolgst du regulatorische und technische Rahmenbedingungen und arbeitest mit daran, ein Umfeld für kunden- und nutzerfreundliche Lösungen zu schaffen

Dein Profil

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du Folgendes mit: 

  • Du hast mindestens 8 Jahre Berufserfahrung, idealerweise als Manager:in im Product Marketing oder Go-To-Market Strategie, oder mit einem Hintergrund in der Top-Tier-Managementberatung oder VC - kombiniert mit Product Management Erfahrung
  • Du hast eine ausgeprägt strukturierte und analytische Denk- und Arbeitsweise
  • Du hast bereits eng mit Tech & Product Teams gearbeitet
  • Es fällt Dir leicht, Prioritäten zu setzen, Ressourcen sinnvoll zu allokieren und Projekte strukturiert zu führen, um Go-to-Market Strategien effektiv zu entwickeln und umzusetzen.
  • Du bist erfahren im Management seniorer Stakeholder (VP, MD, Executive Committee)
  • Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um komplexe Ideen klar und überzeugend zu vermitteln
  • Du sprichst fließend deutsch und englisch (jeweils mindestens C1-Niveau)

Besonders interessant sind für uns außerdem: 

  • Erfahrung in einem Scale-up-Unternehmen
  • Erfahrung im Medtech-Bereich

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Ein von Doctolib gesponsertes Deutschlandticket, wenn Du aus dem Büro oder im Hybridmodus arbeitest
  • Eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung mit tollen Zusatzleistungen
  • 28 Urlaubstage + 1 Tag zusätzlich für jedes volle Beschäftigungs-Kalenderjahr (max. 30 Tage)
  • Teilnahme an Doctolibs langfristigem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth
  • Die Möglichkeit, bis zu 10 Tage im Jahr aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten
  • Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit einem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 40 % (15 % während der Probezeit) 
  • Das Doctolib Parent Care Programm, das einen Monat Elternzeit extra u.v.m. enthält
  • Kostenlose Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über einen externen Partner 
  • Zusätzlich zu gesunden Snacks und einem regelmäßigen Frühstücksbuffet, bieten wir Essensgutscheine
  • Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club
  • Für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen gibt es ein Angebot, das flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung beinhaltet

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager (All gender)
jobs.description:
About Us STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionising the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective — providing operators with a decisive edge in contested environments. 
 We are focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe, today. 

 About the team At the heart of our robotic platforms are robust sensor networks and reliable operating systems. As a Robotics Product Owner, you will be the vital link between high-level system requirements and daily engineering execution. 

 Your mission You will guide a cross-functional team of hardware and software engineers through a rapidly growing portfolio of projects. By taking inputs from system engineers and program managers, you will ensure the team always has clear, actionable, and prioritized work, while keeping the broader organization informed of our technical capabilities. 

 Responsibilities Translate Needs:  Work closely with system engineers and program managers to break down complex system requirements into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria for the engineering team. 

 Push the Backlog:  Regularly align with the team lead to manage and prioritize the team's backlog across the hardware and software stack, balancing long-term foundational architecture with immediate project milestones. 

 Drive Execution:  Facilitate daily alignment across the team—from hardware engineers working on optics and supplier specs, to software engineers building out embedded systems and sensor overlays—to unblock work and keep sprints moving smoothly. 

 Document Capabilities:  Maintain clear, accessible, and up-to-date documentation of our technical capabilities, system resources, and sprint outcomes so stakeholders always know what the team can deliver. 

 Evaluate & Accept Work:  Review completed engineering work against requirements, navigating collaborative trade-offs when friction arises between hardware constraints, embedded software performance, and project timelines. 

 

 Qualifications Experience:  3+ years of experience as a Technical Product Manager, or similar roles, specifically working on hardware-software integrated products, robotics, IoT, or complex technical platforms. 

 Technical Literacy:  You are comfortable reviewing technical structures, navigating code repositories on GitLab, and collaborating effectively with software engineers. 

 Systems Thinking:  A solid understanding of the robotics and embedded tech stack. You should feel comfortable discussing sensor calibration, edge computing (like Jetson platforms), driver integration, and overall system architecture. 

 Communication:  Exceptional ability to communicate complex concepts clearly, acting as the bridge between deeply technical engineers and higher-level program managers. 

 

 Nice to have Familiarity with sensor hardware lifecycles and optics. 

 Experience with embedded Linux, Jetson carrier boards, or base image configuration. 

 Experience with Agile frameworks in a hardware context. 

 Previous experience working in the defense, aerospace, or autonomous vehicle sectors. 
 

 We know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds. If you don't have these exact qualifications but feel you could succeed in this role, please apply anyway.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Audiobooks Format Foundations
jobs.description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience - end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

 We’re seeking a Senior Product Manager to help lead the audiobook experience across Spotify’s mobile apps. You’ll join Format Foundations within Core Experience and partner closely with the Audiobooks business unit to shape how listeners discover, evaluate, enjoy, and build lasting relationships with audiobooks on Spotify.

 What You'll Do 
 

 Lead product strategy for Spotify’s audiobook experience, shaping how the format becomes more engaging, valuable, and enjoyable for listeners, creators, and the business.

 Define and evolve the experience across the audiobook journey, from discovery and evaluation through playback, library management, and reading.

 Partner closely with the Audiobooks business unit to translate business strategy and listener needs into product innovation that supports growth.

 Drive innovation across multimodal experiences, including the intersection of listening and reading.

 Partner with Engineering, Design, Data, and other cross-functional teams to deliver intuitive, high-quality experiences at scale.

 Use data, experimentation, and user insights to make informed product decisions and continuously improve the experience.

 Build alignment across Core Experience, Audiobooks, Personalization, and other partners to create a cohesive Spotify experience.

 Lead complex cross-functional initiatives end to end, setting direction and scope, creating alignment, and partnering with Engineering on delivery.

 Who You Are 
 

 You have 5+ years of product management experience, including meaningful experience with audiobook, ebook, digital reading, or related consumer products.

 You have a deep understanding of the audiobook or digital reading landscape, including user behavior, publisher ecosystems, and competitive dynamics.

 You have experience building consumer products for mobile platforms such as iOS and Android, including complex user experiences.

 You understand how to build scalable systems and experiences that help teams move faster.

 You know how to balance user needs, technical considerations, and business impact when making product decisions.

 You care deeply about creating intuitive, high-quality consumer experiences at scale.

 You have partnered closely with Engineering, Design, Data, and other disciplines to bring products from strategy through delivery.

 You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, making thoughtful trade-offs, and creating clarity across teams.

 You can influence stakeholders across functions and levels to build alignment and drive meaningful outcomes.

 You actively use AI tools in your product development workflow, including for research, analysis, iteration, and prototyping.

 Where You'll Be 
 

 This role is based in Stockholm or London

 We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Werde Teil unseres Teams als Product Manager und entwickle die Accounting-Produkte, die Qonto zum zentralen Finance-Workspace für KMU in Deutschland und darüber hinaus machen.

 Du übernimmst die End-to-End-Verantwortung für unsere Accounting-Expansion auf dem deutschen Markt: von der Produktstrategie über den Ausbau unseres lokalen Angebots bis hin zur Definition der nächsten Schritte, in einem der am stärksten fragmentierten und lokal komplexesten Bereiche im Fintech-Sektor – der deutschen Buchhaltung und dem DATEV-Ökosystem.

 End-to-End-Verantwortung für deine Produkt-Roadmap: Du legst fest, was wir bauen, warum und in welcher Reihenfolge, in Zusammenarbeit mit Engineers, Designer:innen und Fachexpert:innen, um Features zu liefern, die für KMU und ihre Steuerberater:innen in Deutschland wirklich etwas bewirken.

 Du baust tiefes Verständnis für deutsche Buchhaltungsprozesse auf und entwickelst ein scharfes Gespür dafür, wie Buchhaltung in Deutschland tatsächlich funktioniert.

 Du definierst und setzt die deutsche Accounting-Strategie um: Du verstehst Kundenbedürfnisse, wägst ab, was wir selbst bauen oder über Partnerschaften abdecken, und gestaltest ein Angebot, das für deutsche KMU wirklich nützlich ist – nicht nur eine lokalisierte Version dessen, was anderswo funktioniert.

 Du lieferst schneller mit KI: Du nutzt KI-Tools (Dust, Notion AI, Claude) und setzt sie gezielt dort ein, wo Automatisierung Buchhaltung von einer Pflichtaufgabe in einen Wettbewerbsvorteil verwandeln kann.

 Du hinterfragst den Status quo: Du stellst Annahmen infrage, baust schnell Prototypen und arbeitest auf das bestmögliche Produkt hin.

 Du arbeitest mit maximaler Squad-Autonomie: Dein Squad besitzt seine eigene Roadmap, wählt seine eigenen Ansätze und liefert unabhängig – ohne Freigabeebenen und ohne auf Gremien zu warten.

 Fließendes Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch: Du bewegst dich souverän im deutschen Markt. Buchhaltung ist extrem lokal geprägt, und ein direktes Verständnis des Marktes ist entscheidend. Sehr gutes Englisch wird für die funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit mit Qontos europäischen Teams benötigt.

 Ein Markt im tiefgreifenden Wandel: Du baust Qontos Accounting-Angebot in diesem Markt von Grund auf und gestaltest die Strategie mit.

 Volle Squad-Autonomie: Du triffst deine eigenen Entscheidungen und lieferst ohne Bürokratie – ohne Gremien und ohne lange Freigabeketten.

 Uneingeschränkter Zugang zu den besten KI-Tools: Claude, Dust, Notion AI, Cursor, Copilot, jedes Tool, das du brauchst, ohne Genehmigungsprozess.

 Tasks

 Adaptive Collaboration: Decide when the system should ask, explain, interrupt, remind, wait, or deliberately not infer

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About us Since 2000,  ITA Logistics Group  has been making shipping simpler, more transparent, and more efficient for businesses. With our platforms  LetMeShip  and  ParcelParcel , companies can quickly compare and directly book their daily shipping needs. By bringing together a wide range of carriers on our platforms, we combine modern technology with personal service. 
 Across several locations in Europe, our teams work every day to simplify shipping processes in a sustainable way. We believe in open collaboration and fast decision-making. That’s why we are looking for people who take ownership, contribute ideas, and want to actively shape the future with us. 

 Your mission As our (Technical) Product Owner (m/f/d), you will be part of our Product Team and take ownership of key technical interfaces and integrations across our platforms. Your main focus will be on our Customer APIs, the Unified Carrier Interface (UCI), and, going forward, the Unified Financial Platform (UFP) as well as our HubSpot integration. 
 You will work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and Business. You understand technical dependencies, translate different requirements into clear priorities, and work closely with our teams to ensure that our integrations are reliable and continuously evolving. 
 You will collaborate closely with our Product Owners, Technical Business Analyst, Software Engineers, and Data Insights team while also acting as an important point of contact for internal stakeholders, customers, carriers, and external partners. 

 Your Key Responsibilities You own and continuously develop the roadmap for our Customer APIs across LMS Enterprise and LMS Next. 

 You drive the migration of our API customers from LMS Enterprise to LMS Next, identifying and prioritizing the features and carrier integrations required to make the transition successful. 

 You act as a technical point of contact for our API customers, supporting them with questions, troubleshooting, and technical challenges. 

 You take ownership of the development of our Unified Carrier Interface (UCI) in close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders. 

 You analyze requirements for carrier features and services, translate them into clear requirements for Engineering, and support QA in defining relevant test cases. 

 You communicate directly with our carriers to clarify technical requirements and integration specifics. 

 Once live, you take ownership of our Unified Financial Platform (UFP) and manage its backlog, requirements, and further development. 

 You continuously monitor our existing HubSpot integration and prioritize adjustments based on evolving business needs and feedback. 

 Across all these areas, you connect Engineering, business stakeholders, carriers, and external partners, ensuring clear requirements, priorities, and decisions. 

 

 What you need to succeed You have a technical background, for example in Software Engineering or Computer Science, or several years of experience working at the intersection of Product and Engineering. 

 You have experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager, ideally working with APIs, platforms, or technical integrations. 

 You have a solid understanding of APIs, API design, versioning, and migration strategies and feel confident engaging in detailed technical discussions with engineers.
 

 You are able to understand complex technical topics and translate them clearly for different audiences.
 

 You are confident in stakeholder management and know how to balance and prioritize competing technical and business needs.
 

 You are comfortable managing multiple workstreams and adapting to changing priorities while keeping a clear overview of what matters most.
 

 You enjoy working collaboratively across teams and locations, including with colleagues in Hamburg and Naarden.
 

 You are curious about AI tools and digital solutions and enjoy exploring new ways to improve productivity, processes, and workflows.
 

 Experience in logistics, parcel, or freight tech, particularly with carrier API integrations, is a plus. 

 Familiarity with HubSpot or CRM integrations, as well as financial or invoicing systems and interfaces, is also a plus. 

 Across all these areas, you connect Engineering, business stakeholders, carriers, and external partners, ensuring clear requirements, priorities, and decisions. 

 

 Why ITA Logistics Group? You can expect a work environment where new ideas are genuinely welcomed and feedback is not just accepted, but actively encouraged. We challenge the status quo, embrace agile ways of working, and continuously evolve. This also means making use of modern digital tools and AI-driven solutions that support your day-to-day work and help make processes more efficient.
